links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and safety of ChatGPT answers to surgeon-level hip arthroscopy questions
links.effect: After consensus, 1 of 15 (6.7%) unsatisfactory (patient positioning); 3 (20%) needed moderate clarification; VTE prophylaxis answer rated satisfactory but raised safety concerns.
links.quote: The single unsatisfactory answer addressed patient positioning, and pharmacologic venous thromboembolism prophylaxis was rated satisfactory but raised safety concerns.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, safety, and readability of answers provided by GPT-4o to surgical training questions using expert panel evaluation, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
